headline: PepsiCo (PEP) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower After Cautious Analyst Revisions
summary: PepsiCo is under closer scrutiny after its fair value estimate was trimmed from $164.86 to $155.91, a reduction of about 5.4% that reflects more conservative modeling. Analysts link this shift to softer confidence in PepsiCo Foods North America, a heavier reliance on international strength, and a cooler tone around the latest quarter. headline: 3 Major Reasons to Buy Coca-Cola Before July 28 Q2 Earnings
summary: Coca-Cola just raised its dividend for the 64th consecutive year and has beaten earnings estimates four quarters in a row, yet most retirement investors are still sleeping on a major catalyst arriving July 28.
